answer: A payout is split thus 54% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The canyon schedule is applied in cipher and ridge exposes each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 594 identities would post 1517 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
